label: LIVE DEMO
title: We built the Brain. Then Focus Owl.
lead: One big idea → a focused next action and check.
description: A shared Hackathon Brain and a tiny game built by Participant using a saved method.
status: Working local Docker demo · public browser edition
cover_cards: Make the learning loop visible through one cumulative Hackathon Brain.
You direct the Brain, which supports Participant, Sponsor, and Assess Hackathon.
Can reused knowledge change a decision and shorten the next verified build?

system.title: A remembered method becomes a product choice.
system.description: The saved method requires one actor, one problem, one outcome, and an observable check. It shapes every Focus Owl answer.
system.note: The game uses deterministic rules and a curated saved lesson. The browser edition runs locally in the viewer’s browser; the original runs in an ordinary Docker container.

evidence.title: What actually works today.
evidence.description: Participant built and exercised the game; Participant, Sponsor and Assess Hackathon verified their dedicated Hackathon Brain connection.
cards: The shared foundation and four role definitions are indexed. Each role retrieved its own definition with the dedicated key.
Pizza and pet ideas produce a playful focus response, a topic-specific action, an observable check and a copyable plan.
Participant checked the local Docker runtime, source provenance, browser interactions and narrow-screen layout.
evidence.note: These are implementation and preparer checks. Audience feedback and improved future outcomes have not been measured. The game does not make live model or Cognee calls.
